title: Quán Âm Pagoda
geometryBasis: Named Lao Tu Street site, six mapped roof extents, the exact public-domain Qualla entrance photograph and the original source terrain.
sectionBasis: Three front openings with red piers and green hoods; successive halls with rose ceramic tiles, upward eaves and small ceramic figures, flanked by lower rooms.
limitations: The 2008 exterior includes the street gateway, four halls and narrow side ranges. The separate garden across the street and interior artwork are outside the scope.
The exact foreground photograph governs colors, roof curves and the entrance. The heights and ornament of the rear ranges and inscriptions are estimated or simplified.
